$comment: StarUI catalog — every building block of the StarOrga design system, where it lives, its status and which surfaces use it. Rules: docs/DESIGN-RULES.md. Render docs/CATALOG.md with `npm run catalog`.

surfaces.web: Verse Companion Web (Angular PWA) — StarOrga/Verse-Companion-Web, src/
surfaces.app: Verse Companion App (Electron + Angular modules) — StarOrga/Verse-Companion-App
surfaces.installer: Verse Companion installer (plain HTML) — StarOrga/Verse-Companion-App, installer/

layers.core: Tokens and brand every surface shares. layers/core.css
layers.components: Building blocks used by web AND desktop (CSS base, Web Component on top when it has behaviour). layers/components.css

statuses.stable: In StarUI, documented, used by at least one surface; changes follow semver.
statuses.experimental: New or not yet evaluated. Either in StarUI (file marked EXPERIMENTAL) or still at home in a consumer (`home` names it). Marked in code with `ds-new: <reason>`.
statuses.deprecated: Still shipped for compatibility; do not use in new code.

entries.name: Design tokens (surface, text, accent, border, shadow, blur, category, status colours)
entries.notes: Web aliases these as --sc-* in src/styles.scss; the app ships a generated themed copy (scripts/theme/generate-theme-css.js).

entries.name: Radius tokens --radius-sm/md/lg/xl
entries.notes: Desktop-only today (max 4px). Superseded by core.scale once that is stable.

entries.name: Shared scales: radius 2/4/8/pill, type floor 13px + type steps, 4px spacing steps
entries.notes: Decided 2026-11-21 (concept 'Design-System Angleichung'). Additive, no consumer reads it yet.

entries.name: Font families Inter / Orbitron / Caveat / Share Tech Mono
App logo (wordmark)
entries.notes: Inventory 2026-11-22: both consumers carry a diverged copy (app renamed the SCC text comment to VC; web has its own variant). StarUI must take over the current version.

entries.name: App icon (taskbar svg, ico, png 16–512)
entries.notes: Generated by npm run gen:icons. App copies differ from StarUI (2026-11-22).

entries.name: Product marks: vc-mark, uploader-mark, starscape-mark (+ tray, mono)
entries.notes: Not in StarUI yet. Brand files belong in StarUI only → move to assets/brand/marks/.

entries.name: Form base: inputs, selects, .scc-btn buttons
entries.notes: Web uses scAction instead, the uploader its own .btn. Target: one button family per surface, built on these tokens.

entries.name: Tabs / segmented navigation
entries.source: Verse-Companion-Web (beta shell, being reworked in parallel)
entries.notes: Annotation 2026-11-21: web tabs are being reworked in parallel; align after that lands.

entries.name: Uploader buttons .btn / .btn-primary (uppercase outline)
entries.notes: Phase 2: move onto the desktop button tiers (components.forms).

entries.name: scAction: primary (4px, uppercase) / secondary (pill) / tertiary
entries.notes: The web's deliberate look. Candidate for layers/web.css; the pill uses --ds-radius-pill once core.scale is stable.

entries.name: --sc-* token aliases
entries.notes: Bridges StarUI tokens into the web; candidate for layers/web.css.

entries.name: Admin page layout (flat sections, no box-in-box)
entries.notes: Decided 2026-11-21: unnest all admin pages in the beta view; ship detail page (classic, with and without beta) excluded for now.
